readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
the temple struck eleven, which Lina stayed in the kitchen until after
the moment the hall clock struck eleven, when Rosa looked at her kitchen clock

durations: About thirteen minutes of piano playing, from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock
whereabouts: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at about 10:47 by the kitchen clock.
Fräulein Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven.
Fräulein Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen.
Madame was playing the piano during the period from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock.
Rosa was in the kitchen and looked at her kitchen clock when the hall clock struck eleven.
When it was time for the toast, Rosa went up the stairs to fetch the master.
Rosa found the master on the floor of the atelier, by his bench.
Rosa went down the stairs from the atelier.
